title: Online Tutor Payment
scenario: A tutor on social media offers cheap lessons but wants payment before revealing their name.

answers.A: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.B: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.C: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: Online Tutor Payment: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Verify tutors with a parent or school before paying.
